propositions: Three Copilot rebar skills (rebar-implement, rebar-janitor, rebar-debug) silently fail to register due to invalid SKILL.md frontmatter: description field exceeds 1024-char limit or contains unquoted colons that break YAML parsing.
Copilot CLI enforces Agent Skills spec requirements (1024-char description cap, strict YAML parse) but drops non-conforming skills without error or warning.
SKILL.md frontmatter must be converted to YAML folded block scalar format and descriptions trimmed to ≤1024 characters while preserving /rebar-<name> invocation triggers.

A deterministic CI lint (scripts/check_skill_frontmatter.py) must validate all tracked SKILL.md files, asserting valid YAML frontmatter, non-empty description ≤1024 chars, and name conformance to regex and length limits.
The lint check is integrated into make lint target to prevent regression at commit/CI time rather than silent failure at skill-load time.
